title: Simplicial objects of a category, face and degeneracy maps
statement: Let $\Delta$ be the category of the finite totally ordered sets $[n]=\{0<1<\dots<n\}$, $n\geq0$, and order-preserving maps [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and let $\mathcal C$ be a category. A *simplicial object* $K$ of $\mathcal C$ is a functor $K:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$. Its *term of degree $n$* is $K_n=K([n])$; for an order-preserving $\varphi:[m]\to[n]$ the morphism $K(\varphi):K_n\to K_m$ is its *simplicial operator*; the *face maps* are $d_i=K(\delta_i):K_n\to K_{n-1}$ ($n\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq n$, $\delta_i:[n-1]\to[n]$ the increasing injection omitting $i$) and the *degeneracy maps* are $s_i=K(\sigma_i):K_n\to K_{n+1}$ ($0\leq i\leq n$, $\sigma_i:[n+1]\to[n]$ the nondecreasing surjection taking the value $i$ twice). A *morphism of simplicial objects* $K\to K'$ is a natural transformation, i.e. morphisms $K_n\to K'_n$ commuting with all simplicial operators.
